name: Hunza & Karakoram Highway Explorer
meals: Full Board (Authentic Hunza Farm-to-Table & Trail Rations)
overview: A 7-day immersion through the ancient mountain kingdom of Hunza. Designed for adventurous travelers who wish to experience the crown jewels of Gilgit-Baltistan without sacrificing authenticity.
highlights: Sunset over Rakaposhi and Ladyfinger Peak from Eagle's Nest (Duikar)
Crossing the legendary wooden slats of the Hussaini Suspension Bridge
Traditional home-cooked feast with a Wakhi family in Gulmit

itineraryDays.title: Islamabad to Gilgit / Chilas via Karakoram Highway
itineraryDays.details: Fly to Gilgit or scenic road drive through Babusar Pass with views of Nanga Parbat.

itineraryDays.title: Gilgit to Karimabad (Central Hunza)
itineraryDays.details: Drive north along the roaring Hunza River. Stop at the Rakaposhi Viewpoint (7,788m) for traditional tea.

itineraryDays.title: Altit & Baltit Forts + Eagle's Nest Sunset
itineraryDays.details: Walk through ancient stone alleys, tour UNESCO-restored forts, and catch golden hour at Duikar.

itineraryDays.title: Attabad Lake & Passu Cones
itineraryDays.details: Cross through mountain tunnels to Attabad Lake for a boat tour. Continue past Passu Cathedral needles.

itineraryDays.title: Batura Glacier Day Trek & Hussaini Bridge
itineraryDays.details: Trek on the lateral moraine of Batura Glacier, one of the world's longest. Cross suspension bridge.

itineraryDays.title: Khunjerab Pass (China Border at 4,693m)
itineraryDays.details: Ascend to the world's highest paved border in Khunjerab National Park. Spot Himalayan ibex and marmots.

itineraryDays.title: Return to Gilgit & Flight to Islamabad
itineraryDays.details: Transfer to Gilgit Airport for onward flight, taking in aerial views of K2 and Nanga Parbat.

included: All 4x4 Expedition Jeep ground transportation with private driver
6 nights twin-share accommodation in certified alpine lodges
All meals (Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner) specified in itinerary
Experienced local English/Urdu speaking mountain guide
All entry permits, fort entrance tickets, and National Park fees
Emergency medical kit and satellite messenger support
notIncluded: Travel and high-altitude medical evacuation insurance
Personal tips for guides and drivers
preparationAdvice: Prepare for temperature shifts ranging from +25°C in afternoon valleys to near freezing at high passes. Pack layered fleece and waterproof windbreaker.

name: K2 Base Camp & Concordia Expedition Pro
accommodation: Expedition Geodesic Dome Tents + Shigar Heritage Hotel
meals: Full Expedition Catering (Fresh meat, dal, high-calorie mountain chef provisions)
guide: Senior UIAGM / Certified High-Altitude Karakoram Expedition Leader
transport: 4x4 Mountain Jeeps + Dedicated Balti Porter Logistics
overview: The holy grail of global trekking. A true high-altitude expedition walking 120km along the Baltoro glacier to Concordia, sleeping surrounded by four 8,000-meter giants: K2, Broad Peak, Gasherbrum I and II.
highlights: Standing in Concordia, the 'Throne Room of the Mountain Gods'
Reaching K2 Base Camp (5,150m) and the Art Gilkey Memorial
Witnessing the sheer 1,000m granite walls of Trango Towers and Cathedral

itineraryDays.title: Arrival in Islamabad & Briefing at Alpine Club of Pakistan
itineraryDays.details: Expedition equipment check, permit sign-offs, and team welcome dinner.

itineraryDays.title: Spectacular Flight to Skardu (2,228m)
itineraryDays.details: Fly past Nanga Parbat into the rugged Baltistan valley.

itineraryDays.title: Acclimatization & Final Porter Distribution in Skardu
itineraryDays.details: Walk to Kharpocho Fort, finalize 25kg porter loads, and test satellite gear.

itineraryDays.title: 4x4 Jeep to Askole (The Last Village)
itineraryDays.details: Drive through the Braldu River gorge on narrow rocky ledges to the trailhead at Askole (3,040m).

itineraryDays.title: Trek Askole to Korofon (3,100m)
itineraryDays.details: First day on foot crossing the Biafo Glacier snout.

itineraryDays.title: Korofon to Jhola (3,200m)
itineraryDays.details: Follow the roaring Dumordo river; cross the wire suspension bridge.

itineraryDays.title: Jhola to Paiju (3,450m)
itineraryDays.details: Trek through willow groves to Paiju camp, with first glimpses of the Trango Towers.

itineraryDays.title: Rest & Acclimatization Day at Paiju
itineraryDays.details: Porters bake traditional flatbread; climbers take an altitude hike up Paiju Peak ridge.

itineraryDays.title: Paiju onto the Baltoro Glacier to Khoburtse (3,930m)
itineraryDays.details: Step onto the massive rock-covered snout of the Baltoro Glacier.

itineraryDays.title: Khoburtse to Urdukas (4,050m)
itineraryDays.details: Camp on high grassy cliffs directly facing the jaw-dropping Great Trango Towers.

itineraryDays.title: Urdukas to Goro II (4,300m)
itineraryDays.details: Trek onto white glacier ice surrounded by Masherbrum (7,821m) and Muztagh Tower.

itineraryDays.title: Goro II to Concordia (4,691m)
itineraryDays.details: Enter the majestic amphitheater. Unrestricted 360-degree views of K2, Broad Peak, and Gasherbrums.

itineraryDays.title: Day Trek to K2 Base Camp (5,150m) & Broad Peak BC
itineraryDays.details: Walk along the Godwin-Austen glacier to touch the foot of the Savage Mountain and visit the Gilkey Memorial.

itineraryDays.title: Descent Concordia to Goro I
itineraryDays.details: Begin rapid descent down the center of the Baltoro moraine.

itineraryDays.title: Goro I to Bardumal / Paiju
itineraryDays.details: Covering big mileage as thicker oxygen fuels energy levels.

itineraryDays.title: Paiju to Askole Trailhead
itineraryDays.details: Final day on trail; celebratory Balti feast with the expedition porters.

itineraryDays.title: 4x4 Jeep Askole to Skardu
itineraryDays.details: Hot showers and well-earned comfortable beds in Skardu.

itineraryDays.title: Flight Skardu to Islamabad
itineraryDays.details: Debriefing, flight home or onward extension.

included: All Central Karakoram National Park permits and government royalty fees
Professional high-altitude expedition chef and kitchen crew
Full porterage (up to 18kg personal gear per client)
Mountain Hardwear / The North Face 4-season 2-person tents
Dining tent with gas heater, chairs, tables, and solar charging station
Portable Gamow hyperbaric chamber and medical oxygen cylinders
Garmin inReach satellite tracker and emergency beacon
notIncluded: Personal mountaineering / trekking equipment (sleeping bag -20°C, boots)
Helicopter rescue deposit/insurance (mandatory through Askari Aviation)
Porter and guide tips ($150-$200 customary pooled amount)
preparationAdvice: Rigorous cardiovascular training required (trail running, stairmaster with weighted pack 15kg for 4 months prior). Must be comfortable walking 6-8 hours daily on broken glacier moraine.

name: Nanga Parbat & Fairy Meadows Comfort Retreat
travelStyle: Comfort (Alpine Wooden Chalets & Scenic Day Treks)
accommodation: Cozy Pine Alpine Chalets with Wood Stoves
meals: Hearty Alpine Farm Meals & Hot Kashmiri Tea
overview: Immerse yourself in one of the world's most romantic mountain views. Rest in fragrant cedar wood cabins with direct glass views of the shimmering Raikot Glacier and the monumental ice walls of Nanga Parbat.
highlights: Panoramic views of the 8,126m summit from your private cabin balcony
Day trek to Beyal Camp through enchanted pine and birch woodlands
Cozy evenings beside wood-burning cast iron stoves with mountain tales

itineraryDays.title: Islamabad to Raikot Bridge
itineraryDays.details: Scenic drive along the Karakoram Highway to Raikot Bridge on the Indus River.

itineraryDays.title: Raikot Jeep Track & Hike to Fairy Meadows (3,300m)
itineraryDays.details: Mountain jeep to Tattu village; scenic 3-hour hike through pine forests to the meadows.

itineraryDays.title: Day Trek to Beyal Camp & Nanga Parbat Viewpoint
itineraryDays.details: Walk along the glacier edge to Beyal Camp (3,500m) with up-close views of hanging seracs.

itineraryDays.title: Fairy Meadows Exploration & Reflection Lake
itineraryDays.details: Photography at the natural reflection pool, forest walks, and cultural village tea.

itineraryDays.title: Descent to Tattu, Jeep to Raikot, Return Transit
itineraryDays.details: Hike down to Tattu, transfer to AC vehicle, and journey to Gilgit or Islamabad.

included: Round-trip private 4x4 mountain jeep from Raikot Bridge to Tattu village
Horses / porters to carry luggage up the trail so you hike with only a daypack
3 nights in deluxe private pine chalets with attached modern bathrooms
All meals cooked fresh on site by expert local mountain cooks
Professional guide and local escort
notIncluded: Personal riding horses (optional for hiking portions)
Tips for local jeep drivers and porters
preparationAdvice: Easy to moderate fitness required. Good broken-in hiking boots and walking poles make the 3-hour forest ascent effortless.

name: The Grand Karakoram & Gilgit-Baltistan Luxury Odyssey
travelStyle: Premium (Luxury Heritage Palaces, Private Chauffeurs & Flights)
accommodation: Serena Heritage Forts (Shigar & Khaplu) & Luxury Domes at Attabad Lake
meals: Fine Mountain Dining & Traditional Royal Feasts
transport: Luxury Prado / Land Cruiser with Domestic Mountain Flights
overview: The ultimate luxury expedition through northern Pakistan. Stay in restored 400-year-old royal Tibetan/Balti palaces, cruise turquoise glacial waters in private speedboats, and cross the flower-carpeted Deosai high plateau.
highlights: Staying in the royal suites of the 400-year-old Shigar Fort and Khaplu Palace
Private luxury glamping suspended over the turquoise waters of Attabad Lake
Spotting Himalayan Brown Bears across the endless emerald rolling plains of Deosai

itineraryDays.title: VIP Arrival in Islamabad & The Monal Welcome Dinner
itineraryDays.details: Private executive transfer, briefing, dinner overlooking the Margalla Hills.

itineraryDays.title: Scenic Mountain Flight to Gilgit & Transfer to Hunza
itineraryDays.details: Breathtaking flight over the Himalayas. Drive to Karimabad in luxury Prado.

itineraryDays.title: Royal Heritage of Hunza: Baltit & Altit Palaces
itineraryDays.details: Private access tours with royal historians; tea in the queen's apricot orchards.

itineraryDays.title: Attabad Lake VIP Glamping & Passu Cathedral
itineraryDays.details: Private catamaran on Attabad; check into heated geodesic lakeview dome.

itineraryDays.title: Khunjerab Roof of the World Safari
itineraryDays.details: Excursion to the 4,693m China border with gourmet high-altitude heated picnic.

itineraryDays.title: Scenic Highway Transit to Skardu
itineraryDays.details: Drive through the dramatic Indus-Gilgit river confluence into Baltistan.

itineraryDays.title: Shigar & Cold Desert Sunset Safari
itineraryDays.details: Explore 400-year-old Tibetan woodwork; sunset over the white sand dunes of Sarfaranga.

itineraryDays.title: Khaplu Palace & Chaqchan Mosque
itineraryDays.details: Drive to the lush valley of Khaplu; visit the 14th-century wooden mosque.

itineraryDays.title: Deosai Plateau & Sheosar Lake Expedition
itineraryDays.details: Ascend to 4,114m in 4x4 Land Cruisers; picnic on the shores of crystal Sheosar Lake.

itineraryDays.title: Shangrila Resort & Upper Kachura Lake
itineraryDays.details: Relax by the heart-shaped lake; private boat ride on Upper Kachura.

itineraryDays.title: Flight Skardu to Islamabad
itineraryDays.details: Aerial flight over the Karakoram; luxury farewell dinner in Islamabad.

itineraryDays.title: Homeward Flight Transfers
itineraryDays.details: VIP executive airport transfer for your international connection.

included: All luxury accommodations (5-star hotels & boutique heritage forts)
All domestic air tickets (Islamabad-Gilgit and Skardu-Islamabad)
Dedicated air-conditioned Toyota Prado / Land Cruiser with experienced chauffeur
All fine dining meals including chef-prepared regional specialties
Dedicated private lead guide, heritage historian, and concierge service
All VIP admissions, boat rentals, and National Park permits
notIncluded: Personal spa treatments and premium alcoholic beverages
preparationAdvice: Relaxed physical requirement. Suitable for travelers of all ages seeking deep cultural intimacy and majestic alpine views in supreme comfort.

name: Mont Blanc Summit Classic Alpine Ascent
accommodation: Chamonix Chalet & High Alpine Refuges (Tete Rousse & Gouter)
meals: French Savoyard Alpine Hut Dinners & Energy Packs
guide: Certified IFMGA / UIAGM Mountain Guide (1:2 Client-Guide Ratio)
transport: Chamonix Valley Cable Cars & Mont Blanc Tramway
overview: Tackle the highest peak in Western Europe. Includes 3 days of acclimatization and technical ice axe/crampon refresher training followed by a 3-day summit window via the historic Gouter Route.
highlights: Standing on the highest summit of the Alps at 4,808 meters
Tackling the famous Bosses Ridge knife-edge snow crest
Sunrise over the French, Italian, and Swiss Alps simultaneously

itineraryDays.title: Rendezvous in Chamonix & Technical Gear Check
itineraryDays.details: Meet your UIAGM guide, fit technical crampons, harness, and mountaineering boots.

itineraryDays.title: Acclimatization & Glacier Training (Torino Hut / Valle Blanche)
itineraryDays.details: Practice French 10-point cramponing, ice axe arrest, and moving together on rope.

itineraryDays.title: Aiguille du Tour Ascent (Acclimatization Summit)
itineraryDays.details: Climb to 3,540m over mixed rock and snow; return to Chamonix for rest.

itineraryDays.title: Nid d'Aigle to Tete Rousse Refuge (3,167m)
itineraryDays.details: Take the Mont Blanc Tramway; hike up to the refuge beneath the Grand Couloir.

itineraryDays.title: Grand Couloir, Gouter Ridge & Summit Push (4,808m)
itineraryDays.details: Cross the Couloir at dawn, scramble the Gouter Ridge, push past the Vallot hut to the summit crest.

itineraryDays.title: Descent to Chamonix & Celebratory Dinner
itineraryDays.details: Descend the ridge early, catch the tramway back to Les Houches, and celebrate in Chamonix.

included: Certified IFMGA / UIAGM Mountain Guide for all 6 days (strict 1:2 ratio on summit push)
All high-mountain refuge overnight fees with half-board (breakfast & dinner)
All cable cars, mountain trains (Aiguille du Midi, Tramway du Mont Blanc)
Group technical safety equipment (ropes, carabiners, ice screws, first aid)
notIncluded: Personal mountaineering gear rental (stiff boots, crampons, ice axe, harness)
Chamonix hotel nights outside the package
preparationAdvice: Prior crampon experience highly recommended. Must be capable of continuous 8-10 hour aerobic exertion with 1,200m elevation gain in thin air.
